verdict.rationale: AWS as a cloud platform is proprietary and its core service source is not published, but AWS does open-source certain developer tooling — the CDK is explicitly documented as 'an open-source software development framework' and AWS publishes open-source MCP servers on GitHub (awslabs/mcp) and an open-source CLI. This only covers peripheral tooling, not the core AWS service source. Missing for 10: evidence of the core AWS platform/service source code being published under an open license, and explicit license text/repo for CDK or CLI.
